failures.root_cause: sed command references TEST_TEMP_DIR variable that was not expanded before being passed as the sed script argument, causing sed to treat the literal string as a file path
failures.fix: ensure TEST_TEMP_DIR is exported or properly quoted so it expands inside the sed expression, or use a different substitution approach

failures.root_cause: sed command references a literal string '$TEST_TEMP_DIR' as a filename instead of using it as a variable in a substitution expression
failures.fix: Fix the sed invocation to properly escape or quote the substitution pattern, e.g. use sed "s|$TEST_TEMP_DIR|/tmp/replacement|g" file.txt instead of passing the pattern as a filename argument
